R0045.title: Points Theft
R0045.definition: Misappropriating non-monetary benefits from a stolen payment card or another user's account.
R0045.description: Using stolen payment card or account login credentials and payment information to misappropriate or steal non-monetary benefits. Login credentials come from carding attacks (R0040), and payment information comes from card cracking (R0041).
R0045.influence: Non-monetary benefits in the payment card or account are misappropriated or stolen.

references.title: Stealing Mileage Points and Credit Card Fraud: How 'Black Ticket Agents' Operate
Li Chen's Mileage Card Fraudulently Used by Over Ten People

observables: Account points or mileage are redeemed or transferred in a concentrated manner shortly after a remote login
The device environment for points redemption requests is inconsistent with the account's historical environment, accompanied by proxy-login characteristics
Points from the same account are redeemed to multiple different beneficiaries or third-party accounts
The shipping address for redeemed gifts is a new address or significantly different from the account's historical addresses
High-value points are consumed rapidly during off-peak hours, with redemption frequency far exceeding historical patterns

R0045-001.title: Points Redemption Reselling
R0045-001.definition: An illegal profit-making scheme that uses other people's points for personal gain.
R0045-001.description: Fraudsters obtain other people's points through various means, then use those points for redemptions, and resell the redeemed gifts or services for profit.
R0045-001.influence: Disrupts market order and infringes on consumer rights.

references.title: Ping An Bank Credit Card Upgrades Black Market Crackdown: 'Black Hawk Eye' Precision Strike
Li Chen's Mileage Card Fraudulently Used by Over Ten People

observables: Gifts redeemed from points are listed in bulk on second-hand platforms at prices significantly below official value
The same beneficiary or shipping address receives points-redemption gifts from multiple different accounts
After points redemption, gifts from an account flow to a fixed batch of recipients or resale channels
Points redemption frequency and volume surge within a short window, with redeemed gift types highly concentrated
Points redemption behavior across multiple accounts is highly similar in timing, exhibiting batch scripting characteristics
